result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would make it so that no one could fully ignore the inner reality of another living thing. Not forced empathy, but a built-in awareness: when someone else is suffering, it registers in you like your own pain; when someone else is unseen, it feels like your own erasure.

I think almost every kind of cruelty depends on being able to look away. I would take away the looking away.
